properties.answer: Yes — build it next. "Put the store on the MCP surface — content_put / content_get / content_exists. It's the smallest thing that turns working code into a usable capability, and three accepted requirements sit behind it." (Anthony, 2026-07-31.)
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “A capability nothing can call is not delivered — the content store needs a surface”
properties.question: The storage for diagrams and documents is written and working, but nothing an assistant can actually call reaches it — so today nobody can put a file in or get one out. Should adding those calls be the next thing built?
